question: How small can the sealed R47I reachable macro-dead witness be made by deleting clauses from its original exact 3-CNF while preserving exact original->R42 reachability to a genuine residual state with zero accepted frozen R45A pivots?
property_under_minimization: candidate source remains a nonempty exact 3-CNF with no tautological clause
canonical R42 run from that source reaches STALLED_FIXED_SUCCESSOR
reached formula passes full genuine residual integrity: R33 unchanged stack-lean, affine reject, RUP unchanged/replay PASS, SA-BVE none
every bipolar frozen R45A candidate has DP replay PASS, polynomial envelope PASS, independent macro replay PASS, and accepted=false
no semantic terminal escape occurs in the frozen R45A macro normalization for any bipolar pivot

minimization_algorithm.candidate_blocks: contiguous blocks in current canonical clause order
minimization_algorithm.per_round_choice: among all preserving deletions at the current block size, choose the deletion producing the lexicographically smallest canonical source hash; then repeat at the same block size
minimization_algorithm.parallel_evaluation: up to 4 process workers; scheduling is not proof authority
minimization_algorithm.final_single_clause_pass: exhaustive over every clause of the final source; PASS-minimality requires zero preserving one-clause deletions

required_result: all rejected final single-clause deletion tests or digest thereof
all final per-pivot macro receipts and independent replays
forbidden: modify or extend R45A grammar during minimization
use SAT truth labels or external SAT solver as selector
discard failed deletion attempts from the result ledger
claim minimized finite counterexample proves P!=NP
